category.description: Leboncoin category ID. Verified IDs: 9 = Ventes immobilières (real estate sales), 10 = Locations (rentals), 2 = Voitures (cars), 6 = Équipement auto, 17 = Téléphones, 33 = Offres d'emploi (jobs). For other categories, find the ID in any leboncoin.fr search URL (e.g. ?category=N) or use startUrls. Used only when no startUrls.
